source: LLaMA explicitly replaced ZXNAME0000XZ with ZXNAME0001XZ and reduced the hidden width relative to a ZXMATH0000XZ ZXNAME0002XZ to account for the third matrix. [8] PaLM likewise used ZXNAME0003XZ and emphasized compute-equivalent comparisons. [10]
zh: LLaMA 显式地将 ZXNAME0000XZ 替换为 ZXNAME0001XZ，并减少相对于 ZXMATH0000XZ ZXNAME0002XZ 的隐藏宽度以说明第三个矩阵。 [8] PaLM 同样使用 ZXNAME0003XZ 并强调计算等效比较。 [10]
